capabilities: export a note or selected content as an image file or clipboard copy
add text or image watermarks and author information
batch export all notes in a folder as images
split long articles into multiple images
adjust output resolution and image width via a WYSIWYG interface
extras: README notes that on mobile, exported images can only be saved to the current vault due to device limitations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn an article into a shareable image, including options like watermarks or author attribution for sharing.

relations.evidence: This repo borrows lots of code from dom-to-image-more.

summary: Image exporter that converts notes to images saved to disk or clipboard, with watermarks, author info, adjustable width, and batch export.
